note: The platforms an activity can sit on, each assessed in its own right and each with an accountable owner (G-83). Two kinds live here and the difference matters. A platform with entries in `provides` is a COMMON CONTROL PROVIDER: what it provides is inherited by everything that uses it, so an activity behind enterprise identity does not answer six identity questions. A platform with none is an ASSESSED SERVICE: it provides nothing, and its assessment says what may be put on it. Most carry some of both. `allowedData` is the sharper half either way — the mismatch between what an activity wants to place somewhere and what the platform is cleared for is a finding the product can raise on its own. Every platform carries an attestation with an expiry: past it the inherited answers stop counting, because inheritance that outlives its evidence is how control failures get laundered. Owners here are placeholders until real sign-in exists; they are the accountable person, not a persona.

platforms.name: Microsoft Entra ID
platforms.purpose: Enterprise identity. Single sign-on, conditional access and the directory every other system authenticates against.

conditions: Directory data stays in the EU and US tenants only.

platforms.name: Microsoft Authenticator
platforms.purpose: The second factor. Push approval and one-time codes for everyone with a corporate identity.

conditions: Enrolment is mandatory; exceptions are time-boxed and recorded.

platforms.name: Okta
platforms.purpose: Identity for customer-facing and legacy applications not yet migrated to the enterprise directory.

conditions: Migration to the enterprise directory is in progress; no new integrations without an exception.

platforms.name: Amazon Web Services landing zone
platforms.purpose: The sanctioned cloud tenancy. Hardened accounts, baseline guardrails, network boundary and backup.

conditions: Restricted data requires a dedicated account.
EU personal data stays in eu-west-1 or eu-central-1.

platforms.name: Google Cloud
platforms.purpose: Secondary cloud tenancy, used by analytics and a small number of legacy services.

conditions: No Restricted data. No new workloads without architecture review.

platforms.name: Snowflake
platforms.purpose: The enterprise data warehouse. Governed analytics data, with role-based access and column masking.

conditions: Restricted data requires column masking and a named data owner.
EU personal data stays in the EU deployment.

platforms.name: Databricks
platforms.purpose: Model development and feature engineering for the data science team.

conditions: No Restricted data.
Production models are promoted through the sanctioned pipeline, not from a notebook.

platforms.name: GitHub Copilot
platforms.purpose: Code completion and suggestion inside the sanctioned development environment.

conditions: Source code only. No customer or employee personal information in prompts.
Repositories holding trade-secret algorithms are excluded by policy.
Contractual no-training term in force; telemetry disabled.

platforms.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
platforms.purpose: Drafting, summarising and retrieval across mail, documents and meetings, grounded in what the signed-in person can already reach.

conditions: Grounding honours the requester's own permissions; it does not widen them.
No Restricted data, and no special-category personal data.
Meeting transcription is off by default and enabled per team with a recorded reason.

platforms.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
platforms.purpose: Low-code building of conversational agents by teams outside engineering.

conditions: Agents may read only sources their publisher can already reach.
No agent may take an action against a system of record without a named approver.
No Confidential or Restricted data without a separate assessment.

platforms.name: Microsoft 365 Agent Studio
platforms.purpose: Building and publishing agents into the Microsoft 365 surface, including ones that act on a person's behalf.

conditions: Agents that act, rather than only answer, need a bounded authority statement and a named owner.
No Confidential or Restricted data pending the first full assessment.
Newly released; the control set below is provisional.

platforms.name: Anthropic Claude
platforms.purpose: General-purpose model access for engineering and analysis, through the enterprise agreement.

conditions: Contractual no-training term in force.
No Restricted data. No special-category personal data.
Prompts and outputs are retained for thirty days for abuse monitoring only.

platforms.name: Salesforce
platforms.purpose: Customer relationship management for sales and service.

conditions: No special-category personal data.
Predictive features are assessed separately before enablement.

platforms.name: Workday
platforms.purpose: The human resources system of record.

conditions: Works-council consultation required before new analytics use.
EU employee data stays in the EU tenant.

platforms.name: ServiceNow
platforms.purpose: Service management, change and the incident record.

conditions: No customer personal data in ticket free text.
Generative agent features assessed separately.

platforms.name: Coupa
platforms.purpose: Procurement, supplier onboarding and the contract record.

conditions: Supplier risk scoring from external data sources is assessed separately.

platforms.name: Zoom
platforms.purpose: Video conferencing, including recorded client calls.

conditions: Recording requires all-party notice.
AI summarisation and any new sub-processor assessed before enablement.

platforms.name: Atlassian
platforms.purpose: Engineering planning and the internal knowledge base.

conditions: No personal data in issue free text.
Spaces holding Confidential material are permissioned, not open by default.

platforms.name: SAP
platforms.purpose: Finance, the general ledger and statutory reporting.

conditions: Change to anything touching the ledger follows financial-reporting change control.

platforms.name: Oracle
platforms.purpose: Legacy database estate still hosting two regulated applications.

conditions: Closed to new workloads; migration in progress.

platforms.name: IBM
platforms.purpose: Mainframe services underpinning claims settlement.

conditions: Change windows are fixed and shared with the claims business.
